buyer_position: Freeze the specification revision, drawings, bill of materials and approved manufacturing site. Require advance product/process/site change notice and written approval for material changes.
evidence_action: Ask Engineering to define materiality, test impact, stock treatment and who can approve a change. Retain the change ID, cost and effective revision.
escalate_owner: Unannounced substitution or a change affecting safety, certification or interoperability. Engineering/Quality + Procurement + Legal.

buyer_position: Attach measurable factory/site acceptance tests, data, sample size, conditions and pass thresholds. Delivery, installation, beneficial use and payment do not themselves equal acceptance.
evidence_action: Name the test owner, retest deadline, defect log and written acceptance record. Link milestone payment to the stated result, not the supplier's invoice date.
escalate_owner: No objective criteria, deemed acceptance before testing, or acceptance despite unresolved critical defects. Engineering/Quality + Legal.

buyer_position: Sample buyer position: 12 months from written acceptance, with agreed repair/replacement/retest and treatment of repaired parts. Confirm storage and commissioning assumptions.
evidence_action: Record the actual agreed trigger, duration, exclusions, claim method, return logistics and remedy deadlines. A different trigger needs a visible business decision.
escalate_owner: Warranty starts before the buyer can test, or the exclusive remedy cannot restore essential functionality. Quality + Procurement + Legal.

buyer_position: Attach or cross-reference the quality agreement, revision and precedence. Allocate audit, traceability, nonconformance reporting, corrective action and recall/cooperation duties.
evidence_action: Align technical standards with the purchase agreement; specify who investigates, funds remediation and approves restart. Capture supplier flow-down obligations.
escalate_owner: Safety/regulated-product gaps, inconsistent quality schedules or unowned recall decisions. Quality + Engineering + Legal; regulatory specialist if needed.

issue: End of life and last time buy
buyer_position: Require usable end-of-life/change notice, a last-order window and documented support/spares plan. Notice periods must match forecast, tooling and obsolescence costs.
evidence_action: Procurement validates demand and inventory exposure; Engineering validates alternatives. State quantities, lead times, cancellations and storage terms in the last-time order.
escalate_owner: Single-source discontinuation without replacement qualification or unbounded take-or-pay. Supply Chain + Engineering + Finance + Legal.

buyer_position: Read warranty, indemnities, delay remedies, confidentiality, exclusions and the aggregate cap together. Propose defined exceptions or higher caps for specifically allocated risks.
evidence_action: Model plausible exposure and available cover; do not treat a cap figure as expected loss. Record each claim category, aggregation rule and approved cap.
escalate_owner: Express unlimited liability, contradictory caps or safety/data/IP risks left unallocated. Senior Legal + Finance; relevant specialist.

buyer_position: Specify relevant insurance, limits, territories, periods and endorsements with the risk/insurance owner. Obtain a current COI and the evidence needed to verify contractual requirements.
evidence_action: Track policy dates, covered entity, required endorsement and renewal owner. A COI is evidence to check, not a substitute for the underlying policy.
escalate_owner: Missing/expired evidence or wording promising cover not in the policy. Insurance/Risk + Procurement + Legal. Texas example: source S3.

buyer_position: State the selected Incoterms 2020 rule, exact place/point and suitable transport mode. Separately state title, acceptance, price-change notice and customs responsibilities.
evidence_action: Procurement and Logistics sign off on freight, insurance and landed-cost assumptions. Preserve accepted PO prices unless a documented amendment says otherwise.
escalate_owner: Unclear transfer point, mismatched trade term/mode, or unilateral retroactive price changes. Logistics + Finance + Legal. Source S2.

buyer_position: Separate buyer tooling/materials, supplier background IP, deliverables, licenses, documentation and access needed for support or a replacement source.
evidence_action: List assets, custodians, permitted uses, return rights and practical access at insolvency/exit, subject to relevant law and third-party rights.
escalate_owner: Supplier owns buyer-funded improvements without usable rights, or exit depends on unavailable data. Engineering + IP Legal + Procurement.

buyer_position: Tie deposit, delivery and acceptance amounts to named evidence. Separate a disputed invoice from undisputed amounts; specify notice, cure and proportionate suspension/exit rights.
evidence_action: Finance validates budget, currency, taxes, invoice requirements and credit exposure. Retain recovery, service transition, spare-parts and open-order actions.
escalate_owner: Advance payment without safeguards, disputed acceptance treated as complete, or critical supply stopped without an agreed path. Finance + business owner + Legal.
